name: Broccoli Cheddar Melts with Sun-Dried Tomato & Pine Nut Mixed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
When onion is soft, add broccoli, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Reduce heat to medium and add water to the skillet; continue to cook until the water is evaporated and broccoli is tender, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Add mayo, vinegar, and half of the cheese to the skillet with the broccoli; stir to combine. (Reserve remaining cheese for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp white wine vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Split rolls in half and place, cut-side facing up, on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil until lightly toasted, about 1 minute.
Remove baking sheet from the oven and divide broccoli mixture between toasted rolls; top with reserved cheese. Return to the oven and broil until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with pine nuts and mixed greens; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
⅓ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide broccoli-cheddar melts and salad between plates. Enjoy!
